svg.desc: The files of the Hugging Face repository Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B at commit 15852e8c and the loader that reads each: config.json to AutoConfig; tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and chat_template.jinja to AutoTokenizer; the optional generation_config.json (absent at this commit) to generate; the index and the single safetensors shard to from_pretrained, which takes the model code from modeling_qwen3_5.py in the Transformers library. Two range requests read only the shard's JSON header.
